summary.text: Chantelle Ankerman is the Republican candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 60, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she is running against incumbent Jane Garibay (D / Working Families Party / Independent Party of Connecticut).
Her campaign website describes her as an attorney and longtime Windsor resident.

paragraphs.text: Ankerman's campaign website says she is a lifelong Connecticut resident who has lived in Windsor for the past decade.
It says she earned her undergraduate and law degrees from the University of Connecticut and worked for West Hartford Public Schools for more than eight years before her legal career.
The site says she is running to represent Windsor and Windsor Locks, with a focus on affordability, accountability and practical solutions.
